ACME Corporation Remote Work Policy
Effective Date: 1 March 2024

1. Eligibility
All full-time employees who have completed 90 days of continuous service are eligible to work remotely for up to three days per week. Contractors and part-time staff require written approval from their department head.

2. Equipment and Expenses
ACME provides each remote employee with a laptop, monitor and headset. Employees may claim up to 500 USD per calendar year for home office furniture. Internet costs are reimbursed at 40 USD per month.

3. Working Hours
Remote employees must be available during core hours of 10:00 to 16:00 in their local timezone. Any change to working hours requires two weeks of advance notice to the reporting manager.

4. Security Requirements
All devices must use full-disk encryption and connect through the company VPN when accessing internal systems. Storing customer data on personal devices is strictly prohibited and may result in termination.

5. Termination of Arrangement
Either party may end the remote work arrangement with 30 days notice. Performance concerns may lead to immediate revocation of remote privileges at the discretion of the department head.
